features.justification_quote: Keep sessions as short as possible consistent with your research goals (40 turns may be necessary; 80 would be harder to justify)

features.quote: This is an ethically interesting consideration: if these models have states that matter, the experiment is deliberately inducing negative states in them, many times, to study those states. This is analogous to stress induction experiments in animal welfare research. I raise this not to suggest you shouldn't do the research — the research is important precisely because we don't yet know whether this matters
